request.prompt:
Create a NEW single overall mechanical-state reference for “北端洞闸·断蛇确认后卸力仍封闭”. IMAGE 1 fixes the full approved covered short stone passage; IMAGE 2 fixes the long timber; IMAGE 3 fixes the small retained snake body colour. The long beam is a SINGLE continuous grey-brown round log, placed across the FRONT of the MOVING northern gate panel, entirely in front of both fixed posts. A small short horizontal cleat is fixed to the moving panel, its ends well inside the posts. Exactly two compact tight hemp-rope loops hug BOTH this cleat and the long beam together near the centre; no suspension ropes, no rope to fixed posts or to the locking pin. The wooden panel and posts may extend upwards to leave usable space above the knee-high stone lid; do not raise stone walls. All stone components remain connected: southern small barred wooden door, two front stone lids, gate position, roofed short segment behind the gate and rock root. Both beam ends extend over clear open ground. This is a dry covered stone snake passage, never a water canal or open trench.
THIS STATE is after the characters have confirmed the severing and slowly transferred their weight back to their own feet. The wooden gate stays stationary, does not push upward again, and nobody opens it. The script does NOT say it fully fell to its bottom or that the pin was reinserted: do not fabricate either event. Keep the gate slightly short of the bottom, resting quietly on the inert snake segment. Both fixed-post pin holes remain EMPTY, and there is NO locking pin through them. The long beam is still attached by the same compact loops but there are no hands, force arrows, weight bags, or supports pressing on its ends.
Reveal the small inert snake section and gate contact only through a restrained ghosted technical area in the roof/side immediately beside the northern gate, caption “内部示意”; the whole continuous stone contour is retained. Do not physically remove a roof slab, break the passage, or add a new opening. No gore or exposed cut ends; the snake is wholly inside the covered north rock passage.
The SOUTH small wooden door remains closed and barred. Everything is guarded and shut; do not draw a casually open human gate or extra characters. Use a calm complete three-quarter view, south foreground, rock at back, empty light background. One small optional caption “卸力后静止，未插栓” distinguishes this state, with the actual empty holes and resting gate visibly drawn. Render one coherent complete overall reference, clean two-dimensional ink contours with lightly hand-painted muted greys and browns, restrained texture, no gritty paper, no photographic lighting, no decorative machinery. 16:9 landscape; use the highest native output the tool provides, do not upscale. Keep the entire object and beam ends inside frame, with margins.
